```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 0: Load the Data
# ====================================================================
# Load the dataset exactly as you saved it from Phase 1
stars1 <- readRDS("stars_cleaned_eda.rds")

# ====================================================================
# STEP 1: PRE-PROCESS (LOCF on Long Data)
# ====================================================================
stars1_locf <- stars1 %>%
  # 1a. Sort chronologically for each student
  arrange(student_id, grade) %>%
  group_by(student_id) %>%
  # 1b. Safely fill fixed demographic traits backwards and forwards ACROSS ROWS
  fill(student_gender, student_race, birth_year, birth_month, .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup()

# ====================================================================
# STEP 2 REVISED: PIVOT TO WIDE FORMAT (Keeping ALL Confounders)
# ====================================================================
stars1_wide <- stars1_locf %>%
  # 1. Select absolutely everything, but drop the manual lags if you want 
  # (because Wide format natively creates lags, e.g., math_score_K IS the lag for Grade 1).
  # If you want to keep them, just leave them in the time-variant list.
  select(-math_lag1, -math_lag2, -math_lag3) %>% 
  
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    # 2. Put ALL time-variant variables here so they split by grade
    values_from = c(
      math_score, class_type, class_size, area_type, free_lunch,
      school_id, teacher_id, teaching_years, teacher_degree, teacher_career, 
      teacher_gender, teacher_race, 
      treads, tlists, wordsk, motivr, selfco, readbs, mathbs
    ),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{grade}"
  ) %>%
  # 3. Create the missingness indicator
  mutate(stayed_g3 = as.numeric(!is.na(math_score_3))) %>%
  # 4. Factorize (You will need to add the new categorical variables to this list)
  mutate(across(c(student_gender, student_race, 
                  starts_with("class_type"), starts_with("free_lunch"), 
                  starts_with("area_type"), starts_with("teacher_gender"),
                  starts_with("teacher_race"), starts_with("teacher_degree"),
                  starts_with("teacher_career")), as.factor))

# Quick sanity check
cat("New Dimensions of Wide Data:\n")
dim(stars1_wide)
saveRDS(stars1_wide, "stars1_wide_final.rds")
```

```{r}
library(future)
# ====================================================================
# STEP 3: MICE Imputation (Imputing Z and A)
# ====================================================================
# We MUST drop student_id from the imputation process, otherwise MICE 
# will try to use the student's ID number as a numeric predictor, 
# which will ruin the math and take forever to run.

# We create a specific dataset just for MICE by stripping out the math hazards:
# 1. Drop all IDs (Student, School, Teacher)
# 2. Drop class_size (redundant with class_type)
# 3. Drop stayed_g3 (we will use it later in WeightIt, not here)
stars_mice_input <- stars1_wide %>%
  select(
    -student_id,
    -starts_with("school_id"),
    -starts_with("teacher_id"),
    -starts_with("class_size"),
    -stayed_g3
  )

cat("Running Parallel MICE Engine... (Unleashing the 9800X3D!)\n")

imp_data <- futuremice(
  stars_mice_input, 
  m = 20, 
  maxit = 20, 
  parallelseed = 2026207,      # 保证并行计算结果可重现

)

# 跑完后关闭并行池，释放后台资源（好习惯）
plan(sequential)

# Check if it succeeded!
cat("Parallel MICE successfully completed!\n")
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 4: 持久化保存 (Optimized Version)
# ====================================================================

cat("Saving results to disk...\n")

# 1. 保存 mids 对象 (用于诊断)
saveRDS(imp_data, "stars_mice_mids.rds")

# 2. 生成长表 (建议 include = FALSE，除非你需要对比原始缺失情况)
stars_imputed_long <- complete(imp_data, action = "long", include = FALSE) %>%
  # 关键：利用行号一一对应贴回 student_id
  # 只有当 stars_mice_input 的行序与 stars1_wide 完全一致时才有效
  mutate(student_id = rep(stars1_wide$student_id, times = imp_data$m)) %>%
  # 将 .imp 和 .id 移到前面方便观察
  select(student_id, .imp, .id, everything())

# 3. 保存长表 (用于后续分析)
saveRDS(stars_imputed_long, "stars_imputed_long.rds")

cat("Success! Total rows saved:", nrow(stars_imputed_long), "\n")
```

```{r}
# 1. 提取填补后的数据集 (通常对 m 个数据集分别操作，这里以第 1 个为例)
completed_data <- complete(imp_data, 1)

# 2. 定义所有需要还原 NA 的成绩列
# 根据你的 Wide Format，我们需要还原 K 到 3 年级的所有成绩
math_cols <- c("math_score_K", "math_score_1", "math_score_2", "math_score_3")

# 3. 执行还原：只保留协变量的填补，成绩设回原始的 NA
stars_dr_prepared <- completed_data %>%
  mutate(
    student_id = stars1_wide$student_id,
    stayed_g3  = stars1_wide$stayed_g3
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(math_cols), ~ stars1_wide[[cur_column()]]))

# --- 快速检查 ---
cat("检查点 1: 数学成绩是否含有 NA?\n")
print(colSums(is.na(stars_dr_prepared[, math_cols]))) 
# 预期结果：这些列的 NA 数量应与 stars1_wide 完全一致

cat("\n检查点 2: 协变量（如 free_lunch_K）是否还有 NA?\n")
print(sum(is.na(stars_dr_prepared$free_lunch_K)))
# 预期结果：0 (已被 MICE 填满)
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 5: Missingness Model (The IPW Basis)
# ====================================================================

# 1. 拟合逻辑回归模型
# 我们使用 MICE 填补好的完整协变量来预测 'stayed_g3' (即 Ri)
miss_model <- glm(
  stayed_g3 ~ student_race + student_gender + birth_year + 
              free_lunch_K + area_type_K, 
  data = stars_dr_prepared, 
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

# 2. 计算倾向得分 pi_hat
stars_dr_prepared <- stars_dr_prepared %>%
  mutate(pi_hat = predict(miss_model, type = "response"))

# --- 快速检查 ---
cat("检查点 3a: 倾向得分 (pi_hat) 摘要\n")
print(summary(stars_dr_prepared$pi_hat))

# 检查 Positivity Assumption: 是否所有 pi_hat 都严格大于 0 且小于 1？
cat("\n检查点 3b: 是否存在极端的权重 (Positivity Check)?\n")
# 如果有值非常接近 0 (例如 < 0.01)，则需要注意
print(range(stars_dr_prepared$pi_hat))
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 6: Outcome Model & DR Estimation (The Grand Finale)
# ====================================================================

# 1. 拟合结果模型 (Outcome Model)
# 我们只在观测到 Y3 的样本上训练。
# 变量选择：使用 MICE 填好的 100% 完整变量，确保“共轭性” (Congeniality)
outcome_model <- lm(
  math_score_3 ~ class_type_3 + student_race + student_gender + 
                 free_lunch_3 + area_type_3 + teacher_degree_3, 
  data = subset(stars_dr_prepared, stayed_g3 == 1)
)

# 2. 生成预测值 m_hat (针对全体样本)
# 因为自变量在第四步后都是完整的，所以这里不会产生任何新的 NA
stars_dr_prepared$m_hat <- predict(outcome_model, newdata = stars_dr_prepared)

# 3. 执行 AIPW (Doubly Robust) 计算公式
# 根据 Seaman (2018)，公式为：E[m_hat + R/pi_hat * (Y - m_hat)]
stars_dr_final <- stars_dr_prepared %>%
  mutate(
    # 计算误差修正项：如果是缺失值(R=0)，修正项为 0；如果是观测值(R=1)，进行逆概率加权
    dr_correction = ifelse(stayed_g3 == 1, 
                           (1 / pi_hat) * (math_score_3 - m_hat), 
                           0),
    # 每一位学生的 DR 贡献值
    dr_pseudo_outcome = m_hat + dr_correction
  )

# 4. 汇总结果：得到全校范围内的无偏均值估计
final_summary <- stars_dr_final %>%
  summarize(
    DR_Mean = mean(dr_pseudo_outcome),
    Observed_Mean = mean(math_score_3, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sample_Size = n()
  )

# --- 快速检查 ---
cat("检查点 4: 最终 DR 估计 vs 原始观测均值\n")
print(final_summary)
```
```{r}
# 对比原始分布和 DR 修正后的均值分布
ggplot(stars_dr_final) +
  geom_density(aes(x = math_score_3, fill = "Observed"), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_density(aes(x = dr_pseudo_outcome, fill = "DR Adjusted"), alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "Effect of DR Adjustment on Math Score Distribution",
       x = "Year 3 Math Score", fill = "Method")
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 7: 最终因果效应评估 (Causal Effect via DR)
# ====================================================================

# 1. 对比不同班级类型在 DR 修正后的得分
final_effect <- stars_dr_final %>%
  group_by(class_type_3) %>%
  summarize(
    DR_Adjusted_Mean = mean(dr_pseudo_outcome),
    Observed_Mean = mean(math_score_3, na.rm = TRUE),
    # 偏差修正量：负值表示该组流失了较多差生
    Bias_Correction = DR_Adjusted_Mean - Observed_Mean 
  )

# 正确的替代方案：衡量班级类型对三年级成绩的影响，同时控制背景
final_model <- lm(dr_pseudo_outcome ~ class_type_3 + student_race + free_lunch_3, 
                  data = stars_dr_final)

summary(final_model)
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 7: 构建用于 ANOVA 的长表 (集成 DR 修正值)
# ====================================================================

# 1. 提取 K, 1, 2 年级的原始观测数据 (以及背景协变量)
stars_long_base <- stars1_wide %>%
  select(student_id, 
         # 选择我们要分析的成绩和班级类型
         math_score_K, math_score_1, math_score_2,
         class_type_K, class_type_1, class_type_2) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -student_id,
    # 正则表达式：(变量名)_(年级后缀)
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(K|1|2)", 
    names_to = c(".value", "grade_label")
  ) %>%
  mutate(grade = case_when(
    grade_label == "K" ~ "Grade 0",
    grade_label == "1" ~ "Grade 1",
    grade_label == "2" ~ "Grade 2"
  )) %>%
  select(-grade_label)

# 2. 准备 Year 3 的 DR 修正数据
# 注意：列名必须与上面的 math_score 和 class_type 完全一致
stars_g3_dr <- stars_dr_final %>%
  select(student_id, class_type_3, dr_pseudo_outcome) %>%
  rename(math_score = dr_pseudo_outcome, 
         class_type = class_type_3) %>%
  mutate(grade = "Grade 3")

# 3. 合并
stars_long_final <- bind_rows(stars_long_base, stars_g3_dr) %>%
  mutate(
    grade = factor(grade, levels = c("Grade 0", "Grade 1", "Grade 2", "Grade 3")),
    class_type = factor(class_type)
  ) %>%
  # 剔除那些在特定年级没有班级记录的学生行（可选）
  filter(!is.na(class_type))

# --- 验证数据结构 ---
cat("检查点 6: 最终长表结构\n")
str(stars_long_final)
# 预期：11601 * 4 = 46404 行左右，列只有 student_id, math_score, class_type, grade
```

```{r}
# 重新整合长表，确保每个 student_id 都有 4 行
stars_long_final <- stars_long_final %>%
  # 这一步会自动补齐缺失的年级行
  complete(student_id, grade) %>%
  # 关键：我们需要把 class_type 补齐，因为 ANOVA 不允许自变量缺失
  group_by(student_id) %>%
  fill(class_type, .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup()

# 再次检查行数
cat("修正后行数:", nrow(stars_long_final), "(预期应接近 46404)\n")
```

```{r}
# 运行 ANOVA
# math_score 是包含 DR 修正值的混合得分
# class_type 是班级类型
# grade 是年级（0-3）
model_anova <- aov(math_score ~ class_type * grade, data = stars_long_final)

cat("\n--- 最终双因素方差分析结果 ---\n")
summary(model_anova)

# 进一步查看交互作用的具体表现 (Post-hoc)
cat("\n--- 交互效应各组均值 ---\n")
print(model.tables(model_anova, "means"))
```

```{r}
# 运行 Tukey 事后检验，重点看各个年级下 class_type 的两两对比
TukeyHSD(model_anova, which = "class_type:grade")
```

```{r}
# 定义三种不同复杂度的结果模型
specs <- list(
  "Minimal"  = math_score_3 ~ class_type_3 + student_race,
  "Standard" = math_score_3 ~ class_type_3 + student_race + free_lunch_3 + student_gender,
  "Full"     = math_score_3 ~ class_type_3 + student_race + free_lunch_3 + student_gender + 
                               area_type_3 + teacher_degree_3
)

# 循环计算不同模型下的 DR Mean
sensitivity_results <- lapply(specs, function(formula) {
  m <- lm(formula, data = subset(stars_dr_prepared, stayed_g3 == 1))
  m_hat <- predict(m, newdata = stars_dr_prepared)
  # 使用之前算好的 pi_hat
  dr_pseudo <- m_hat + ifelse(stars_dr_prepared$stayed_g3 == 1, 
                              (1/stars_dr_prepared$pi_hat)*(stars_dr_prepared$math_score_3 - m_hat), 0)
  mean(dr_pseudo)
})

print(unlist(sensitivity_results))

```

```{r}
# 对权重进行修剪 (Trimming)
stars_dr_final <- stars_dr_final %>%
  mutate(weight = 1/pi_hat,
         # 将极端的权重限制在 5% 到 95% 分位数之间
         trimmed_weight = pmin(pmax(weight, quantile(weight, 0.05)), quantile(weight, 0.95)))

# 计算修剪后的均值
trimmed_mean <- mean(stars_dr_final$m_hat + 
                     ifelse(stars_dr_final$stayed_g3 == 1, 
                            stars_dr_final$trimmed_weight * (stars_dr_final$math_score_3 - stars_dr_final$m_hat), 0))

cat("原始 DR 均值:", 616.41, "\n权重修剪后均值:", trimmed_mean)
```

```{r}
# 模拟：假设流失学生的真实成绩比模型预测的还要低 delta 分
deltas <- seq(0, 20, by = 5) # 假设低 0 到 20 分
impact_on_ate <- sapply(deltas, function(d) {
  # 对 R=0 的人减去 delta
  adjusted_pseudo = stars_dr_final$dr_pseudo_outcome
  adjusted_pseudo[stars_dr_final$stayed_g3 == 0] <- adjusted_pseudo[stars_dr_final$stayed_g3 == 0] - d
  
  # 重新运行模型看 class_typeSmall 的系数
  coef(lm(adjusted_pseudo ~ class_type_3, data = stars_dr_final))["class_type_3Small class"]
})

names(impact_on_ate) <- deltas
print(impact_on_ate)

```
